summary: A medieval-themed groovebox forked from GHOULBOX and Felucca, for tavern and court dances with lutes, hurdy-gurdies, shawms, bagpipes, frame drums and the medieval modes.
features: 13 engines on four tracks, incl. a hurdy-gurdy with ringing drones
64-step sequencers with chance, ratchets, conditions and Euclid
Pythagorean, meantone and just temperaments; arpeggiator and chord keys
KEY TOUCH: velocity and aftertouch from the FM-1's own keys
MIDI learn, program change, a channel per track; screen reader support
Opens Felucca and GHOULBOX projects; sounds still mostly GHOULBOX's

headings: estampie: a mediæval groovebox for the fm-1
